## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to.

### permit `clerks_refund_small_low_amounts_in_period`

- On `refund`, it allows 36 combinations; no other permit allows 28 of them.

`tests/gen/asked.gate`

```gate
permit clerks_refund_small_low_amounts_in_period
  principal in clerk
  action refund
  when amount <= 50GBP
  when kind is low
  when in_period
```

`cedar/asked.cedar`

```cedar
@id("asked/clerks_refund_small_low_amounts_in_period")
permit (
  principal in Asked::Role::"clerk",
  action == Asked::Action::"refund",
  resource
)
when { context.amount <= 50 }
when { context.kind == "low" }
when { context.in_period };
```

### permit `managers_refund_on_business_days`

- On `refund`, it allows 64 combinations; no other permit allows 56 of them.

`tests/gen/asked.gate`

```gate
permit managers_refund_on_business_days
  principal in manager
  action refund
  when business_day
  unless note
```

`cedar/asked.cedar`

```cedar
@id("asked/managers_refund_on_business_days")
permit (
  principal in Asked::Role::"manager",
  action == Asked::Action::"refund",
  resource
)
when { context.business_day }
unless { context has note && context.note };
```

### permit `clerks_review_what_they_cannot_refund`

- On `review`, it allows 48 combinations, and no other permit allows any of them.

`tests/gen/asked.gate`

```gate
permit clerks_review_what_they_cannot_refund
  principal in clerk
  action review
  when cost <= 80GBP
  unless memo
  unless allowed refund(amount: resource.total, kind: low, on: resource.paid_on)
```

`cedar/asked.cedar`

```cedar
@id("asked/clerks_review_what_they_cannot_refund")
permit (
  principal in Asked::Role::"clerk",
  action == Asked::Action::"review",
  resource
)
when { context.cost <= 80 }
unless { context has memo && context.memo }
unless { context.allowed_refund };
```

## Computed values

What an action computes and gives Cedar in its context. The generated code computes each one from the service's own data, the operation's arguments and the server's clock, and never takes it from the caller. The pages of the rules and the dates are the pages for people that rulec and koyomi draw, as they draw them.

### `in_period` of `refund`

- Written: `in_period = today <= refund_terms.last_day(paid_on: on)`
- Computed as `today <= koyomi "examples/refunds/dates/refund_terms.cal" date last_day`: koyomi gives the date from `on`, and the value is yes when today is on or before it.
- Today is the date at the offset +00:00 from UTC (the line `today`).
- Its values: yes and no (true and false in Cedar).

</details>

### `business_day` of `refund`

- Written: `business_day = today is open in uk`
- Computed as `today is open in koyomi "examples/refunds/calendars/england_and_wales.cal"`: yes when today is a business day of the calendar.
- Today is the date at the offset +00:00 from UTC (the line `today`).
- Its values: yes and no (true and false in Cedar).

`in_period` and `business_day` both read today. Computed by koyomi on every day of the declared ranges, each of the 4 sets of their values can happen.

### `allowed_refund` of `review`

- Written: `allowed refund(amount: resource.total, kind: low, on: resource.paid_on)`
- Whether `refund` is allowed for the same principal and resource, on the same day. The generated code asks it first, through the function of `refund`, and puts the answer in the context before it asks this action; why `refund` was refused, when it was, is why this request is refused.
- What the inputs of `refund` are given: `amount` ← `resource.total`, `kind` ← `low`, `on` ← `resource.paid_on`.
- Its values: yes and no (true and false in Cedar).
- Its values are as the table of `refund` on this page says.

### `allowed_review` of `escalate`

- Written: `allowed review(cost: cost, memo: memo)`
- Whether `review` is allowed for the same principal and resource, on the same day. The generated code asks it first, through the function of `review`, and puts the answer in the context before it asks this action; why `review` was refused, when it was, is why this request is refused.
- What the inputs of `review` are given: `cost` ← `cost`, `memo` ← `memo`.
- Its values: yes and no (true and false in Cedar).
- Its values are as the table of `review` on this page says.

### `allowed_refund` of `ping`

- Written: `allowed refund(amount: 10GBP, kind: low, on: 2026-09-15, note: false)`
- Whether `refund` is allowed for the same principal and resource, on the same day. The generated code asks it first, through the function of `refund`, and puts the answer in the context before it asks this action; why `refund` was refused, when it was, is why this request is refused.
- What the inputs of `refund` are given: `amount` ← `10GBP`, `kind` ← `low`, `on` ← `2026-09-15`, `note` ← `false`.
- Its values: yes and no (true and false in Cedar).
- Its values are as the table of `refund` on this page says.

## Expectations, separations and roles

### Expectations

- `managers_never_escalate_what_they_could_review` (expects deny, on `escalate`). It holds on all 96 combinations it picks.
- `clerks_who_are_not_managers_never_escalate` (expects deny, on `escalate`). It holds on all 48 combinations it picks.
- `managers_ping_what_could_be_refunded` (expects allow, on `ping`). It holds on all 12 combinations it picks.

### Roles

- `clerk`
- `manager`: It includes `clerk`.

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `refund` | `review` | `escalate` | `ping` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `User` holding `clerk` | sometimes | sometimes | never | sometimes |
| `User` holding `manager` | sometimes | sometimes | sometimes | sometimes |

## Operations guarded

No action guards an operation of a contract.
